plainText:
Soshiro Hori (Japanese: 堀総士郎 Hori Sōshirō) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Hori was born sometime on August 21 in , . He became a voice actor as an adult and mostly got minor roles. He joined the during , voicing Team Skull member Zipp, his best-known role to date. Hori is currently affiliated with the talent agency .
